answer_1.quote: Task-oriented dialogue systems (TDSs), which help users to complete specific tasks with natural language, have attracted increasing attention recently due to the broad applications such as event scheduling and flight booking.

answer_2.quote: Following previous works , we evaluate TTOS and compared methods on two automatic evaluation metrics: BLEU  and entity F1  scores.

answer_4.quote: Similar to the previous work , we use human evaluation to evaluate the generated responses from two perspectives: informativeness (Infor.) and humanlikeness (Humanlike.). Specifically, we randomly select 100 dialogues from the CamRest and In-Car Assistant test sets, and invite three annotators to independently assign two scores (i.e., informativeness and human-likeness scores) from 1 to 5 for each generated response.
